location: 倪家桥路与人民南路四段交叉口
interpretation: Map represents parallel one-way carriageways crossed by Nijiaqiao road. The 0.2 m value is a clipped external lane residual, not surveyed junction separation. Raw OSM nodes have no traffic_signals tags; current TLS are experimental inferred controls. Joined variant is a bounded topology hypothesis, not a reconstruction of observed signals.
current_reality_caveat: 2026-06-17 reporting describes recent metro construction fence removal and restored roads. Stored node/way edits date from2024–April2026, so some mapping can predate restoration.

aerial_review.observations: Divided arterial with parallel carriageways, landscaped separators, approach lane arrows, stop lines and broad pedestrian crossings. Static oblique aerial does not establish signal phases/timing or exact current widths.

unknowns: Current lane counts and lane-use restrictions
